format: 1-vs-1 fortress breakout duel: mirrored brick forts top/bottom of a vertical grid arena, cores auto-fire balls that smash enemy bricks (steel 2 hits, bomb chain reactions, x2 split bricks), segmented core-HP bars above/below, slow-mo final hit, losing fort collapses in a chain reaction
theme: shark vs octopus (ocean-animal 'who would win' 1-vs-1 matchup: the obvious favorite vs the clever underdog)
viral_reason: VARIETY_RULES rule 2 own results (today's s1 Windsor read for eas.ydata: 1-vs-1 'X vs Y' matchups ~10x the views of multi-entrant races), themed with rule 3's evergreen 'which would win' animal matchup; ocean animals are a different family from s1's fire vs ice and from today's food showdowns. No aislop/research/latest.md trend doc yet.
music_style: cinematic: 72 bpm A harmonic minor, saw string pad over a low drone, taiko kit; brick hits pitched up the scale by fort depth, bomb booms, core thuds, riser into the slow-mo final hit, bell fanfare on the winner card
caption:
The shark built its fort up top. The octopus dug in down below.

Three rules of the siege:
Every ball that slips through smashes enemy bricks.
Bomb bricks set off chain reactions.
Crack the other core 8 times and that whole fort falls.

Whose fort is still standing at the end, the shark's or the octopus's?

#sharkvsoctopus #brickbreaker #whowouldwin #oceananimals #chainreaction
